adversarial.storeReadIsTheMiss: The tier-2 flood pattern (608,414 determinations unreachable while the ledger scored 100%) is the miss if assertions read the store. Every C assertion takes a body fetched from the app endpoint.
adversarial.c4WithoutBrowser: C4 is specified as wire vs DOM. Step 1-2 has no browser. The PE-render signal is on the same served body: liveBuildablePct reads envelope.summary.buildableAreaPct, which is absent while buildableAreaSqFt is 9350. That is the C4 fail without sampling a loading DOM.
adversarial.c1c2c5WithoutDom: Those three need a DOM. No skip: each is refused when dom is not supplied. The run still fails on C3/C4/C7.
adversarial.productionCiWouldStayRed: A required CI job that hits production would fail every Factory PR until the three defects are fixed. The gate8 job on Node 24 runs selftest + fixture only. The production arm is this session's acceptance evidence and a later publish trigger, not a PR gate.
adversarial.gate7OnPublishBlocksP4: Wiring requireCountyCostRecord into assertPublishMayComplete would refuse every county close until cost rows exist, which locks P4. The check is armed as assertCountyCloseAllowed / factory close-county, proven by violation, not hooked into bastrop-publish this fan.
adversarial.bundleMarkerIsMap: Neither vite config on hauska-map origin/main a275a45 defines a marker. The define + dataset write + --build-env cannot land in this Factory tree. Exact patch is leave_behind. UNSTAMPED must fail; that assertion is step 5 and is not claimed working this fan.
